summary: Plugin TypeScript chính thức cho Compound Engineering, tích hợp với Claude Code, Codex và Cursor để hỗ trợ AI-assisted code generation
usecases: Enhance AI code completion and agent workflows in Cursor and VS Code
Integrate compound engineering principles into automated code generation pipelines
Provide extensibility for custom engineering plugins in AI-assisted development environments
ideas: Adapt the plugin for local LLMs to enable offline AI-assisted coding with compound engineering patterns
Combine with version control systems to auto-generate commit messages and PR descriptions based on engineering workflows
Develop a marketplace for community-contributed compound engineering plugins for various IDEs
